# Day-0 cards: the first work, in order

"No card, no work" needs a first card. These are it (MVP item field: `Day 0`, GDD ref and Player outcome: `none`).
Their lanes are listed here because the paths don't exist until card 0.3 is merged.
Each line in "Done when" (split at `<br>`) becomes one checkbox. `tests/test_day0_cards.py` files every row through
`tools/check_card.py`, so a row the checker rejects fails CI. `tools/pipeline_check.py` fails on an "After" cycle or an unknown card.

**When.** Pre-jam (before the start, Nov 11 21:00 PST = Nov 12 00:00 EST): 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.7, 0.11, 0.15, 0.16, 0.17, and the generic workbench 0.25, 0.26 (0.11, 0.15, 0.16 and 0.17 still wait for card 0.0, per the Day-1 blockers rule below) (GDD 1.3 §12: synthetic objects only, no umbrella or owl content). Nov 11, after the theme reveal: 0.19, then the story bible 0.34 (Story role).
Every other card makes or needs game files, so it starts at the jam start (D39). "Day 0" below means "before the first MVP card", not a date.
Before the start, `tools/kickoff.sh` on the team repo files and runs only the pre-jam cards in the line below (tools, agent setup, rules and the
synthetic workbench sample: Official Rules §7(h), `docs/pre-jam-declaration.md`); in a practice repo it runs every card. `tools/check_card.py` reads this line:
**Pre-jam cards:** 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.7, 0.11, 0.15, 0.16, 0.17, 0.19, 0.25, 0.26

**Filing.** "After" = cards that must be merged first. The Producer files a card only when all its After cards have merged,
so `check_card.py --lanes` never sees two open cards with overlapping lanes.

**Owners and sign-offs.** Agents own all the work. Column 3 is `<agent role> / <human seat> (sign-off: <kinds>)`: the agent
role builds the whole card; the seat after `/` is the card's Human, who merges it and does only the Done-when lines that start
`HUMAN <kind>:`. Each kind is a true checkpoint in `pipeline/human-checkpoints.md` ("Checkpoint kinds"): `submission`,
`physical`, `guardrails`, `design`, `secrets`, `people`. No seat means the integration owner merges it and nothing else on it is
a person's. A `Human only` reviewer is a sign-off too, so it needs a sign-off kind. When filing, the Producer writes that seat's
person from the `docs/jam-brief.md` People table as the card's Human (the name only). `tools/pipeline_check.py` and
`tests/test_day0_cards.py` fail a row whose owner is a person, a `Human only` reviewer with no sign-off, and a Done-when line
that names a person without its `HUMAN <kind>:` tag (`check_card.day0_owner_problems`).

**Gate paths.** `tools/**`, `tests/**`, `.github/**`, `pipeline/art/style.json`, `pipeline/agent-ops/**` and the rest of
`pipeline/agent-ops/gates.json` are gate files. The hook and the git hooks block every agent from committing them, during the jam too.
Where a lane below holds one, the owner agent still does the work: it writes the change as a git patch to `$JAM_OUTBOX/gate.patch`
(and tests it from that copy); kickoff keeps it as `.pipeline/gate-patches/UE-<id>/` and asks the TD human, who reads it and applies it
with one command, `python3 tools/git_gate.py apply UE-<id>` (it commits as the human, pushes, and puts the `GATE EDIT:` line in the
PR). That apply is the `guardrails` sign-off; the person never writes the change.
Editor scripts that are not gates live in `pipeline/unreal/editor_scripts/`.

**Other card fields.** The table has no Budget, Inputs, Out of scope, Used by or Needs column. When filing, the Producer writes
Budget `60 min agent + 15 min human` (more means split the card; cards 0.3, 0.4d, 0.25 and 0.26 get `120 min agent + 60 min human`, the `check_card.py` caps, as builds on two OSes and gate scripts do not fit 15 human minutes), Inputs = the files its Done-when names,
Out of scope = anything outside the lane, Used by = the cards that list it in After (or none), Needs = what its Done-when runs.

**Day-1 blockers.** Card 0.0 must be done before any other card moves to `doing`, except 0.1, 0.2, 0.7, 0.19, 0.25 and 0.26 (the theme is due Nov 11 even if 0.0 slips). Card 0.0 includes the P0 sign-off (D-new-p0-signoff). GDD 1.3 already authorizes the P0 IDs, so MVP cards pass `check_card.py` now; the Producer files them only after the jam start (D39).

After 0.3 is merged and D-new-p0-signoff is signed, the Producer files the MVP cards for G1 (MVP 1-6, 9, 11), then G2 (MVP 7, 8, 10, 12), each passing `pipeline/checklists/card-ready.md`,
with lanes split per component (`pipeline/unreal/gameplay-code.md`, code layout), so cards can run in parallel.
A card that creates tests writes its own issue number and `merged` in its `pipeline/qa/test-map.md` row, in its own PR.
That file, `docs/decisions.md` (a card adds or edits only its own rows) and `docs/jam-brief.md` (only the lines its lane names) are row-scoped: `check_card.py --lanes` does not count them as shared lanes.

## Post-start generation order (GDD 1.3 §12) mapped onto cards
Every MVP and Stretch card names its feature IDs (APPROVED_P0 IDs are always MVP cards, never Stretch) and `GDD revision:`; `check_card.py` fails it until those IDs are authorized.
| Step | GDD 1.3 §12 | Cards |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | Empty game project from frozen tooling; build | 0.3, then 0.5, 0.6 |
| 17 | 2D arena, player motor, normal falling, open-upright lift | 0.8, MVP 1, MVP 2, MVP 3, MVP 9 (attack descent auto-fire), MVP 11 (safe wind; §12A Nov 12) |
| 18 | Bottom defeat, minimal health, clear restart, simple outcome trigger | MVP 4 (two cards), MVP 5, MVP 6 |
| 19 | One owl, one telegraphed bolt; playtest P0 movement and threat readability | 0.5b, 0.8a, 0.8b, MVP 7, then MVP 10 (shield block and heal; its sound/signal card 0.14b first); a QA-03 playtest |
| 20 | Test harness and telemetry in the game build | 0.27 (MVP 8), 0.23, MVP 12 (sprite loops, two background layers; §12A Nov 13) |
| 21 | Approved options in isolated modules, alone, then combined | One Stretch card per non-P0 feature ID (APPROVED_P1, or EXPERIMENT with a ticket) behind its flag, alone, then in deliberate combinations; presets T-02..T-07 check the P0 parts |
| 22 | Regression, human playtests, scope, polish, package early | 0.6b, 0.6d, 0.24, gates G3 and G4 |
A gated feature's first card may be `Hook only` (interface + flag at its default, no behavior) while the ID is OPEN or PROPOSED.
